STATUTORY DETERMINATION UNDER SECTION 19 OF THE LAND REFORM LAW No. 1 OF 1972

WHEREAS a statutory declaration under Section 18 of the Law has been made by Mr. Diyonis Appuhami Rajapaksha Dissanayake of "Leela Niwasa", Diyapota, Omalpe, the Land Reform Commission by virtue of the powers vested in it under Section 19 of the Law, has made a statutory determination for his estate as he has passed away as of now, specifying the portion of agricultural land owned by the statutory lessee which he shall be allowed to retain. The agricultural land so allowed to be retained by the statutory lessee is described in the Schedule below.

An extent of 42 Acres, 2 Roods, 37.68 Perches from and out of an allotment of land marked Lot A of the land called Rodagale Yaya, Elagoda Hena, Hingurarahene Yaya, depicted in the Advance Tracing No. R/LRC/2013/732(LS), prepared by the Surveyor General, situated in the village called Embilipitiya - Udagama (FVP 778), of Diyapotagam Pattu Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Embilipitiya, in the District of Ratnapura, Sabaragamuwa Province, together with the buildings and plantations thereon.
